title: ReviewSensei bounded current-review verdict v1
description: Host-derived verdict included in the reviewsensei:review-content:verdict:v1 content identity. Runtime result validation binds ordered selected comments to the digest and one admission byte per selected comment; JSON Schema alone cannot express that hash/cardinality relation.

selected_admission.description: Ordered selected admission: A advisory, B blocking, H human decision. Runtime validation requires one byte per bound selected comment.
